Monitor your agents in batch mode with simple natural language using Perplexity Monitor API

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Perplexity Developers (@perplexitydevs); megjelent: 2026-11-23T18:43:59+00:00; link: https://x.com/perplexitydevs/status/2124937019839443452; média: videó, 12 másodperc]
We've added Agent monitors to the Monitor API.

An Agent monitor accepts a task in plain language, runs the Agent API on a schedule, and sends an alert with sources when the answer changes.
